description: K-means clustering adapted from Rodinia 3.1. Feature-major inversion, nearest-center arithmetic, constant-memory centers and CPU centroid sums are retained; texture loads use __ldg. The local driver uses synthetic LCG input seeded with 42 and exactly max_iter assignments, with accumulated per-kernel timing. Upstream uses file input and convergence control.

scaling_param.name: points
scaling_param.description: Number of data points to cluster

non_scaling_params.name: features
non_scaling_params.description: Number of features per data point (constant-memory limit: clusters*features <= 1088)

non_scaling_params.name: max_iter
non_scaling_params.description: K-means assignment iterations per timed pass

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Cold-cache calibration: when true, a vector-add warmer boosts the GPU clock and evicts the last-level cache before each timed iteration, so the kernel is measured cold-cache at a boosted clock (matching a cold-cache simulator). Set false for legacy warm-cache measurement.
